abstract.para: This document defines the update policy and lifecycle strategy for core security components within the &suselinux; 16 code stream.

section.title: Stable security components
section.para: The following security components follow the stable life cycle and remains the same within the same minor version. New versions are typically introduced only to the next minor release:

listitem.para: OpenSSL: The version is fixed for the purpose of FIPS 140-3 certification within the minor release.
GNUTLS, Nettle: The version is fixed for the FIPS 140-3 certification.
libgcrypt: The version is fixed for the FIPS 140-3 certification.

section.title: Balanced security components
section.para: The following security components follow the balanced life cycle and can be updated with a maintenance update or get version update with releasing a new minor release:

listitem.para: &selnx;: Policies are updated with monthly snapshots.
Network Security Services (mozilla-nss): The version is fixed for the FIPS 140-3. However, updates of the package matches the Firefox ESR updates
strongSwan: new versions are typically introduced with new minor release.

section.title: Agile security components
section.para: The following security components follow the agile life cycle and are kept up-to-date with upstream:

listitem.para: ca-certificates-mozilla: Updated when new NSS certificates bundle is released.
